question: Estimate the daily food delivery orders per young professional (22-30) in metros.
idealClarificationQuestions: Average across all young professionals or only food-delivery active? Active food delivery users in this segment.
Per day or per week? Per day (decimal OK).
Average day across the year? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Segment users by intensity, weight by share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Young professional food delivery active users in metros: ~15M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round to ~0.4-0.5 orders per day, or ~3-3.5 per week.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Young professional food delivery active users in metros

calculationFlow: - Lunch + dinner regulars (5+/week meal replacement): 20% = 3M @ ~7 orders/week = 1 per day.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Round to ~0.4-0.5 orders per day, or ~3-3.5 per week.
